customManagers.description: Terraform module version pins in the platform catalog. capabilities_source_base points at 4-platform-engineering/3-capability-modules in this same repo, so the pin resolves against this repo's own git tags. These are the ONLY hand-maintained version pins in the tree — everything else (go.mod, pyproject.toml) is covered by Renovate's built-in gomod and pep621 managers with no custom config. team-iam.tf.tmpl is included alongside catalog.yaml because it hardcodes its own ?ref= pins rather than going through the capabilities: block — see PLAN.md Phase 3.7(d).
